name: Generation Development Group Limited
summary: Generation Development Group Limited engages in the diversified financial service business in Australia. The company operates through Benefit Funds Management and Funds Administration (Generation Life), Research and Ratings (Lonsec), and Managed Account Businesses (Evidentia) segments. It offers investment-linked savings and retirement income solutions; and investment bond products, funeral bond products, and investment-linked lifetime annuities, as well as investment research, ratings, governance, and portfolio services, which connect financial advisers, fund managers, and super funds with tools, data, and insights.
